text:
I’m a passionate and hard-working freelancer with extensive experience in Python and machine learning, and I’d be glad to help set up your Tawk.to chat bot automation triggers across multiple websites.

I’ve built a delivery support chatbot for Parcelwise Logistics using Python, OpenAI API, LangGraph, FastAPI, Redis, and Twilio. It handled WhatsApp and SMS parcel tracking, rescheduling, and smooth human handoff with full context. That project resolved 43% of conversations without an agent and achieved a 4.4/5 CSAT.

For your Tawk.to setup, I can help configure practical automation flows, refine trigger logic, and support ongoing additions as your website portfolio grows. I’m comfortable working with chatbot systems, NLP, and automation-focused integrations, and I’d be happy to contribute long term.
